run_gif_maker_cli: run the gif maker script with --traj-path and --out-path to generate animated GIFs from trajectory files
run_parallelized_generation: run parallelized GIF generation from a trajectory file using multiple worker processes and ffmpeg
run_pov_from_atoms: run povray rendering of a single atomic frame to generate a POV snapshot image file
run_get_parser: run the argument parser to get CLI options for traj-path, out-path, and num-workers
review_pov_from_atoms: review the pov_from_atoms function that separates organic adsorbates from surface atoms and renders POV images
